question_text: According to the course material, organizing is one of the functions of management where the manager is expected to bring his creativity to bear, and the skill very much needed is:
explanation: Organizing demands originality and innovation; design skill is very much needed in organizing.

question_text: According to the course material, organizing demands designing the internal structure of an enterprise, so it needs the manager's:
explanation: Organizing demands designing internal structure and therefore needs the conceptual skill of the manager.

question_text: According to the course material, departmentation by enterprise function groups activities around production, selling and:
explanation: Enterprise-function departmentation treats production, selling and financing as enterprise functions.

question_text: According to the course material, production as an enterprise function is concerned with converting inputs to:
explanation: Production as an enterprise function converts inputs to output.

question_text: According to the course material, departmentation by geographic or territorial area groups activities according to:
option_b: only the colour of the product
option_c: only the age of the founder
explanation: Geographic/territorial departmentation groups activities by location or territory.

question_text: According to the course material, product departmentation is the identification of necessary activities for the production and sales of product, then grouping and assigning them to managers:
option_b: only by the alphabet of surnames
explanation: Product departmentation groups activities and assigns them to managers along product lines.

question_text: According to the course material, product departmentation is a way that top level management uses to delegate to a lower level:
option_a: extensive authority to produce, market and carry out required engineering and services
option_c: only the right to sweep offices
option_d: authority only over the national budget
explanation: Each product manager receives extensive authority not only to produce and market but also to carry out engineering and services associated with the product.

question_text: According to the course material, an advantage of product departmentation is that it provides a good training ground for the position of:
option_a: the General manager or the Managing Director
option_c: only an external auditor of another firm
explanation: The product manager learns to deal with functional specialists and later brings that experience if appointed General manager.

question_text: According to the course material, a disadvantage of product departmentation is that it requires not specialists as product manager but:
option_a: generalists who have the ability to coordinate functional activities
option_b: only engineers with no managerial ability
explanation: Product departmentation requires generalists who can coordinate functional activities; a specialist lacking general managerial ability may favour his own function.

question_text: According to the course material, product departmentation increases the cost of having product managers and subordinates, and these costs are called:
option_a: overhead cost which the organization has to bear
explanation: Creating product-manager levels requires finance for salaries and offices; these are overhead costs.

question_text: According to the course material, under product departmentation profit and cost travel in:
explanation: Profit and cost travel in opposite directions: if profit is to be made, expenses must be reduced.

question_text: According to the course material, departmentation by customer groups activities according to:
explanation: Customer departmentation groups activities by the type of customer served.

question_text: According to the course material, line relationship should be looked upon as purely the flow or exercise of authority from:
explanation: Line relationship is the flow of authority from the top to the bottom.

question_text: According to the course material, staff relationship is purely:
option_a: advisory; their existence depends on the advice they render the line managers
option_b: the same as firing every line manager
option_c: a replacement for all line authority
explanation: Staff relationship is advisory; staff exist to render advice to line managers.

question_text: According to the course material, line authority also called power in this context is:
explanation: The material calls this type of authority power, that is legitimate or position power.

question_text: According to the course material, line relationship makes subordinates respect the directives of their boss since they know that he has the backup of the organization and can:
option_a: give out the necessary punishment in the event of non-compliance
explanation: Subordinates respect line directives because the boss has organizational backup and can punish non-compliance.

question_text: According to the course material, assignment of responsibility must be backed up with commensurate authority, otherwise it:
explanation: When activities are assigned, they must be backed with commensurate authority, otherwise the arrangement becomes ridiculous.

question_text: According to the course material, a limitation of staff relationships is absence of responsibilities for:
explanation: Staff limitations include absence of responsibilities for results, undermining line authority, and a feeling of superiority.

question_text: According to the course material, staff limitations also include undermining line authority and:
explanation: Staff may undermine line authority and feel superior to line managers.

question_text: According to the course material, conflicts between line and staff managers can arise due to changes in technology, ease of control of the line manager's work, introduction of changes, and:
explanation: Causes of line-staff conflict include technology change, ease of controlling line work, introduction of changes, and age differences.

question_text: According to the course material, ways of minimizing line-staff conflicts include removing overbearing attitudes, adopting a patient attitude, avoiding playing the expert, and:
explanation: Minimize conflicts by dropping overbearing attitudes, cultivating patience, not playing the expert, and avoiding technical jargon.

question_text: According to the course material, formal and informal organization are the two types of organization treated, and organizing is still a facet of the management function that applies:
explanation: The course treats formal and informal organization while stressing that organizing applies conceptual and design skills.

question_text: According to the course material, an advantage of product departmentation is that responsibility for profit making is placed at:
option_a: a lower level, just as in geographic departmentation
explanation: Product departmentation places profit responsibility at a lower level, as geographic departmentation also does.

question_text: According to the course material, product departmentation can make economical central services such as bulk purchases by headquarters:
option_a: difficult, because product managers may resent goods purchased without their contribution to the buying decision
explanation: A disadvantage is that it tends to make economical central services such as bulk purchasing difficult, because product managers resent purchases made without their input.
